title: Dispersion
subtitle: Implied vs realized correlation on the S&P 500 top-50
headline: Tuesday 27 October 2026. COR1M 10.6% (very low since 2006), our read from 50 chains 9.6%, realized 7.7%. Implied dispersion 22.5 points with 41 names in earnings; the book at trailing vols is -2.9 points. Top idea: sell the 1-month correlation swap at the COR1M strike.

sections.title: Where correlation trades
paragraphs: The CBOE one-month implied correlation (COR1M) closed at 10.6%, the 46th percentile of its trailing year and the 5th since 2006 (very low). Solving the basket identity with today's 30-day ATM vols of the 50 largest S&P 500 names and SPY gives 9.6%, 0.9 points below the CBOE print.

Realized correlation of the basket over the last 21 days: 7.7% (63-day average 5.5%). Implied sits +2.8 points above trailing realized. Since 2015 the premium over the *following* month averaged +12.3 points and was positive on 85% of days; over the last two years it fell to +2.6.
Term structure: COR3M 13.9%, ratio COR1M / COR3M 0.76, normal: correlation is expected to mean-revert up from here.

sections.title: The book today
paragraphs: SPY 30-day ATM implied vol 13.8% against a weighted average single-name vol of 36.3%: 22.5 points of implied dispersion. 41 of 50 names report earnings inside the tenor; 68% of the chains had no live bid-ask (read after the close).

Vega-weighted dispersion book (long 50 single-name variances, short index variance, Mag 7 = 54% of vega): breakeven realized correlation 9.6% if singles realize their implied, 14.5% if they realize 10% more. If every leg realizes its trailing 21-day vol the book makes -2.9 points per unit of index vega (singles -6.9, index +4.0).

Crash corner of the scenario grid (correlation 80%, singles realizing 1.5x implied): -17.1 points. A crash raises single-name vol and correlation at once, so the index leg loses faster than the single legs gain.

sections.title: Why correlation is where it is
paragraphs: Pairwise 63-day correlation: 20% inside the Mag 7, 7% among the other names, 6% between the two groups. The Mag 7 carry 65% of the basket's variance for 54% of its weight.

The first principal component explains 20% of the basket's return variance (35-45% in 2020-2022). That share and COR1M move together (correlation +0.60 since 2015): one strong market factor means expensive index options and high implied correlation; today's giants trade on their own stories.

sections.title: The short correlation swap, and what it really is
paragraphs: Selling a one-month correlation swap at the COR1M strike every 21 trading days since 2015: 141 trades, +12.4 points per trade on average, 86% winners, worst -24.5 points in March 2025, max drawdown -32.4 points. Gross of a bid-ask that runs several points.

Regressed on the S&P return of the same month, the swap P&L moves +1.57 points per 1% of index move and +0.70 more per 1% on the way down (R² 0.33); its correlation with a short 15-delta put sold at the VIX is +0.36. In the 21 months where the index fell more than 3% the swap lost -2.2 points against +12.4 overall. Selling correlation is selling crash insurance with a different label.

ideas.title: Sell the 1-month correlation swap at the COR1M strike
ideas.instrument: 1m correlation swap on the top-50, strike 10.6%
ideas.condition: COR1M in its bottom quintile since 2006 (5th percentile)
ideas.thesis: When the strike sat in this quintile, implied exceeded the realized correlation of the following month by +4.8 points on average (74% of days). Today's strike is +2.8 points above trailing realized.

ideas.title: Put on the vega-weighted dispersion book
ideas.direction: long single-name variance, short index variance
ideas.condition: Implied dispersion 22.5 pts; 41 names in earnings; breakeven correlation 9.6%
ideas.thesis: At trailing realized vols the book makes -2.9 points per unit of index vega. Single names are realizing below their implied because earnings are priced but not printed: the trade pays only if the prints move the stocks.

ideas.title: Buy correlation (short dispersion) as a crash hedge
ideas.instrument: receive the 1m correlation swap, or short singles / long index variance
ideas.condition: COR1M at 10.6%, bottom quintile; COR1M / COR3M 0.76
ideas.thesis: The hedge costs the premium: -4.8 points per month on average in this bucket. It pays when correlation jumps; the best month for the buyer in this bucket returned +12.1 points (Jul 2024). Cheap insurance by history, negative carry by construction.

method: Ideas are ranked by historical conditional expectation divided by the historical worst case in the same regime. Conditioning variable: the quintile of the COR1M strike since 2006. The dispersion book's worst case is the crash corner of the scenario grid, labelled as a scenario.
caveats: Survivorship: the realized basket is today's top-50 with fixed weights; before 2015 realized correlation is understated.
Correlation swap P&L is gross: no bid-ask (several points on a real swap), no margin, frozen basket.
Option quotes from Yahoo are delayed; after the close most chains have no bid-ask and IVs come from last trades.
